description: This file defines a PHP class 'BlockReferenceNode' that represents a block call node in the Twig templating engine. It extends the Node class, implements NodeOutputInterface, and includes methods for construction and compilation, specifically rendering a yield statement for template blocks.

classes.name: Twig\Node\BlockReferenceNode
classes.description: Represents a block call node in Twig, handling rendering of block contents via generator/yield syntax.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BlockReferenceNode with a block name and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code that yields from a block, facilitating block rendering in templates.
